question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

LONDON, ORQALK, RUTXIH, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 The first three alphabets are increased to 3 positional values.**

 The last three alphabets are decreased to 3 positional values.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd09244c74051465c6c1d3b4cb7c826617752394bc55a46df9771de972273aa4.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
